describes: Current form fill, mirror geometry, values/defaults, authority, interchange, events and lifecycle.

cases.name: hydrates-on-open
cases.covers: One deferred complete snapshot; reads and widget joins are empty until it lands. Authority is per field.

cases.name: no-read-grant-never-lists
cases.covers: The readable mirror stays forbidden and never calls forms.list, including refresh.

cases.name: refresh-coalesces-and-forces
cases.covers: Current mirror coalesces concurrent refreshes; a subsequent explicit refresh starts a fresh load. No force flag.

cases.name: a-failed-load-warns
cases.covers: Current mirror exposes a failed read through error status, without console or kernel reports; refresh recovers.

cases.name: widget-geometry-loads-once-per-page
cases.covers: Complete page-space widget rows arrive with the one form snapshot. ensureLoaded shares that load; no annotation geometry read exists.

cases.name: a-failed-geometry-read-can-retry
cases.covers: Geometry is part of the fields load now; a refused snapshot reports once and explicit refresh retries the full current snapshot.

cases.name: fill-authority-fuses-into-disabled
cases.covers: Per-field fill authority and readOnly determine disabled; ordinary and readonly widgets are independently projected in two sessions.

cases.name: typed-writes
cases.covers: Current family writes use value/checked/selectedValues and current refs; null clears a checkbox via its value vocabulary.

cases.name: writes-serialize
cases.covers: Current fills send in order without waiting for prior answers; pending reads see the later fill until both confirmations land.

cases.name: a-failed-write-reverts
cases.covers: An engine refusal rolls back the pending value and rejects; the next fill confirms normally.

cases.name: the-write-gate
cases.covers: Known fields denied fill reject value/checkbox/choice/reset locally before any apply.

cases.name: commit-value-without-scripting
cases.covers: The public validated setValue replaces commitValue: applied or unchanged comes from result.meta.undoable; a named engine refusal rejects.

cases.name: reset-rides-the-batch
cases.covers: Current reset is one forms.reset ChangeOp and confirmed value facts, with no re-read. Unknown refs select nothing.

cases.name: a-failed-reset-batch-rejects
cases.covers: Current resets are atomic apply changes; exact named engine refusals reject without stale per-entry batch statuses.

cases.name: reset-without-the-batch
cases.covers: Removed applyEffects/reset fallback is replaced by the sole current change queue; successful and refused reset preserve defaults/rollback.

cases.name: set-value-passthrough
cases.covers: Current setValue returns the confirmed field and status; the next refused value leaves it intact.

cases.name: interchange
cases.covers: Current bundles replace FDF/XFDF data doors; export/import/repair use current direct engine services and exact refusals.

cases.name: the-twins
cases.covers: Read/design grants and per-field fill authority are independently exposed by the current twins.

cases.name: the-effect-folds-foreign-events
cases.covers: Current remote and local facts fold directly without reads; deletion removes the field/rows. Desynchronization reloads the complete form.

cases.name: the-effect-refresh-is-latched
cases.covers: While refresh is in flight current mirrors buffer facts, then replay them over the loaded snapshot. The last buffered fact wins, and later facts fold normally.

cases.name: a-reset-action-without-a-batch-door
cases.covers: The host reset action uses the same current forms.reset operation without an actions plugin or any removed batch API.

cases.name: close-unsubscribes
cases.covers: Closing releases the form instance, its mirrors and hooks; reopening constructs a fresh model.

cases.name: geometry-on-an-offset-crop
cases.covers: Current widget rows already carry crop-relative page coordinates, including fractional dimensions; reads preserve them.

cases.name: reads-over-the-snapshot
cases.covers: Current list filters, values, widget addresses and exportValues read complete flat field records and page rows; unplaced widgets are absent.

cases.name: status-without-read-and-after-a-failed-load
cases.covers: The current mirror returns forbidden without read permission and error after a named load refusal.

cases.name: batch-writes
cases.covers: Current batch accepts well-typed fields and reports unknown refs independently; plain import skips missing, forbidden and incompatible values. Accepted fields share one apply.

error.message: no form field has this ref

skipped.reason: the form has no field with this name
a checkbox field can't take this value
you may not fill in this field

cases.name: values-keyed-by-integer-like-names
cases.covers: Plain import/export follow JavaScript integer-like property ordering; the actual apply operation order records that ordering.

cases.name: reset-all
cases.covers: Current reset() selects every fillable resettable field, or explicit refs. Host action exclusion preserves ISO target selection; empty include selects none.

cases.name: reset-all-failures
cases.covers: Explicit denied reset rejects locally; reset waits for the snapshot. Current atomic engine refusal rejects the entire change and the next reset succeeds.

cases.name: confirmed-change-events
cases.covers: Current facts announce value/create/update/widget/remove/delete with exact origins; refresh alone announces resync. Unrelated version facts do not synthesize form writes.

cases.name: an-unsubscribed-listener-hears-nothing
cases.covers: An event hook returns a callable unsubscribe; detaching it prevents the subsequent refreshed snapshot callback.
